name: Sick The
overview: Scripture reveals both the physical and spiritual dimensions of sickness, portraying it not only as bodily ailment but also as a state of deep moral and spiritual brokenness, as seen in Isaiah's depiction of a whole head sick and a faint heart (Isaiah 1:5-6). The responsibility of visiting and caring for the sick is emphasized as a tangible expression of Christlike compassion and duty, highlighted in Matthew 25 where visiting the sick is commended as serving Christ himself (Matthew 25:36, 43). Additionally, the figurative use of sickness illustrates the consequences of sin and rebellion, with Hosea and Psalms showing how spiritual wounds and deceit accompany the state of sickness (Hosea 5:13; Psalms 41:6).
